verdicts.observation: In the last paragraph, "Branzir" is transliterated as 布兰伊尔. That drops the z sound; 布兰兹尔 or 布兰齐尔 would match the name better. The frozen input has no terminology entry for Branzir, so the standard name can't be confirmed here and the host should check it against the term base.

This entry names the same "heat beam rune" two ways. Most mentions use 热能射线符文, but the paragraph "coming around to my left arm where my heat beam rune was inscribed" uses 热束符文. The name is inconsistent within one entry and should be unified. The next entry (99451be0…) uses yet another form, 热能射线束符文, so the two entries also disagree with each other.

1) This entry also names the "heat beam rune" two ways: "I activated the heat beam rune" becomes 热能射线束符文, while later "the heat beam rune inscribed on the bottom of his outstretched arm" becomes 热能射线符文. Entry 939927d6… mainly uses 热能射线符文, so this should be unified to match. 2) "Your moves are too telegraphed" means the moves are obvious and easy to predict. 你的动作太夸张了 changes this to "your moves are too exaggerated" and breaks the logic of the following clause, "your attacks are easily countered". A fix along the lines of 你的动作意图太明显 would keep the meaning.
